PREVIEW: Blackhawks Continue Season-Opening Road Trip Against Mammoth

away.summary: The Blackhawks are coming off a 5-2 season-opening loss to the Vegas Golden Knights, where Patrick Kane scored his first goal back with Chicago after a 1,316-day absence. They will be without injured center Connor Bedard (shoulder) and forward Andrew Mangiapane (lower body), while forward Teuvo Teravainen returns to the lineup after being a healthy scratch in the opener. The team is projected to start Spencer Knight in goal, with Arvid Soderblom as the backup.

home.summary: The Utah Mammoth are set to host the Blackhawks in their season opener, projected to start Karel Vejmelka in goal with Sebastian Cossa as backup. They will be without defenseman Maveric Lamoureux, who underwent shoulder surgery Monday and is expected to miss 4-6 months. The Mammoth are coming into the game with a 0-0-0 record, looking to build on their performance after a preseason that included Lamoureux's injury.
